sections.label: The challenge
sections.heading: In everyday practice, not every case is clear-cut.
paragraphs: Subtle lesions. Early-stage disease. Borderline findings that could go either way. Every optometrist knows the cases that demand a second look—and the weight of interpretation that comes with them.

Variability in retinal image interpretation is well-documented across the industry. Even experienced clinicians can reach different conclusions on the same image. The cost of missing something small is sometimes a patient's sight.
2nd Opinion exists to make those moments easier—by surfacing what the eye can miss and standardizing what trained AI can see.

sections.label: The solution
sections.heading: AI-supported interpretation, built for optometry.
paragraphs: 2nd Opinion analyzes retinal images alongside your clinical review, highlighting regions of interest, flagging potential lesions, and offering confidence signals that inform—but never replace—your clinical judgment.
It acts as a second set of expert eyes on every case, without slowing your workflow or complicating your tech stack.

aside.heading: Not a replacement. A second pair of eyes.
aside.body: 2nd Opinion informs your clinical decisions. It does not make them. Every output is explainable, every finding is reviewable, and every case stays yours to interpret.

items.title: Lesion Visualization
items.body: Clear visual overlays highlight suspicious regions and lesion-level features—so you see what the AI saw, and why it flagged it.

items.title: Decision Support
items.body: Confidence signals and standardized grading help reduce variability in interpretation across clinicians, clinics, and time.

items.title: Workflow Integration
items.body: Designed to fit into existing optometric workflows with minimal disruption. No new hardware required. No workflow rebuild required.

sections.label: How it integrates

items.body: Use your existing retinal camera or import images from your current system. No new hardware. No workflow redesign.

items.title: Reduce Diagnostic Variability
